title: Work begins on a Great Madrasa at Qurṭuba, to serve the city's new worshippers as Islam returns to the old seat of the caliphs
source: Trent's account (February 1358; the exact day isn't given)

title: Foreign Wisdom: Duʿāʾ, the Zenata minister of the Marīnid house, is widely praised for bringing fresh ideas and practices to the court, though the nobility are perturbed that a foreigner serves their amir

Works under way across the realm: the Great Madrasa of Qurṭuba and a madrasa in Jayyān, a spinners' guild in Gharnāṭa, marketplaces in Istijja, Ishbīliyya and Mālaqa, and a gravel road to Yuz Aryuba; the dīwān funds the bureaucracy from the crown's coffers
source: Trent's screenshot (the construction and government panels, 8 August 1358)
